Container.Name: ollama-sycl
Container.Overview: Ollama with an Intel Arc SYCL/oneAPI backend (built from Ollama source). 2x faster than stock Vulkan on Battlemage. Build the image first: git clone https://github.com/mattslow630/ollama-sycl-b70 /mnt/user/appdata/ollama-sycl-b70 && cd /mnt/user/appdata/ollama-sycl-b70 && ./scripts/build.sh

Config.Name: Model Storage
Config.Description: Host path for models (4-20 GB each)

Config.Name: SYCL Cache
Config.Description: Persistent JIT cache - makes model loads fast after first run

Config.Name: ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR
Config.Description: Pin the Arc dGPU; try level_zero:1 if the iGPU is index 0

Config.Name: OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE
Config.Description: Unload models after this idle time (-1 = never)

Config.Name: OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE
Config.Description: KV cache quant: q8_0 halves context VRAM, near-lossless. Requires OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=true. Blank = default f16.

Config.Name: OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION
Config.Description: Required when OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE is set (quantized V cache refuses to start without FA)

Config.Name: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH
Config.Description: Context window in tokens (more = more VRAM)
